pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
You must be {PLAYER}.
Elara said you might stop by.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text: I'm looking for Professor Birch.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
I'm Hazel. Birch meant to stay
at the lab.

Then he heard about more sightings.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
I was sorting his field notes.

He's finding POKéMON missing from
all his older records.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
These are our children, Brendan
and May. They help with his surveys.

pages.speaker: BRENDAN
pages.text:
If you're looking for Dad, try
wherever he was told not to wander.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
He's checking sightings, Brendan.
That isn't the same as getting lost.

pages.speaker: BRENDAN
pages.text: Those aren't mutually exclusive.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
You saw the report, right?

I wonder if those POKéMON
are frightened.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
Strange places. Strange people.

They don't know what's happened
to them either.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text: Yeah. I asked Elara about that too.

pages.speaker: BRENDAN
pages.text:
I'd like to know how they got here.

Without sticking my head in a rift,
before anyone asks.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text: Elara gave me much the same warning.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
Good. Then that's one less person
I have to talk out of something.

pages.speaker: BRENDAN
pages.text:
Speaking of which, when you get a
POKéMON, we should have a battle.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
You'll have to battle me too.

Don't let Brendan claim the only
challenge around here.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text:
I came looking for a professor
and got two challenges instead.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text: A very efficient introduction.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text: Is Colress working with Birch?

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
Birch shares his observations
with the research team.

Colress is coordinating their
investigation.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
Birch puts the POKéMON first.

Someone has to find out how
they're coping.

pages.speaker: MAY
pages.text:
Dad said he was checking Route 101.

Let's finish up and get going.

pages.speaker: BRENDAN
pages.text:
Try the lab on your way.

If he's gone, take the path north
to Route 101.

pages.speaker: HAZEL
pages.text:
Stay on the path until you have
a POKéMON of your own.

If something looks wrong, get help.

pages.speaker: PLAYER
pages.text:
Find Birch. Stay on the path.
No exploring rifts.

That should be simple enough.
